mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey that's as gritty as it is uplifting—one that takes us from the slums of Limerick all the way to the bustling streets of New York. Together, we're about to step into the world of Frank McCourt’s 'Tis, where every moment hums with hope, humor, and just a touch of heartbreak. Have you ever wondered what it truly means to leave everything behind and start over somewhere brand new? In this story, the dream of America meets the tough realities of poverty, identity, and that deep, universal longing to belong. As we travel alongside McCourt, we’ll see the struggle to shake off a heavy past while trying to build something better. We’ll laugh, maybe wince, and definitely reflect as family, faith, and ambition all get tested along the way. Through menial jobs, the ups and downs of education, and the awkward dance of climbing the social ladder, adulthood slowly takes shape—with all of its uncertainty and possibility. Love, loss, and the echoes of childhood cast their shadows, shaping a voice that’s both vulnerable and quietly defiant. What if survival isn’t just about getting by, but about transformation? In 'Tis, Frank McCourt invites us to reflect on how memory and dreams twist together, and how the search for acceptance and purpose can lead to moments of real triumph. So, let’s set out together—ready to discover what it means to come of age in a world full of contradictions, and to find our place, even when home feels a world away.
